about_the_game:
Game Overview

Harrowlight is a third-person survival horror that combines a survival horror experience with exploration in an encapsulating story inspired by classics such as Resident Evil 2 and The Last of Us. Join Grace Cooper, a 'Marshal' for the city of Harrowgate, tasked with extracting a key scientific figure from the town of Waymouth.

Welcome to Waymouth

Waymouth is a city buried in silence and snow. It's history spread across the derelict structures as they stand forgotten. As you move through Waymouth, you'll uncover stories, piecing together a fractured past caused by the dead and people's actions. In Waymouth, exploration is rewarded, adding weapons and items only rewarded to those that explore the desolate area.

Survive the horror

From a desolate town, through a church that seems untouched by time, to an over-run cemetery, across an abandoned military base and through a research facility as you follow your task to extract a vital figure to your home city, but also uncover a sadistic nature from a once renown community member. With secrets off the frozen path around every corner, can you survive?

Key Features

  • Explore a wide area where exploration is rewarded with story and items

  • Equip a wide variety of weapons, from pistols, to shotguns to automatic rifles

  • Skill-Based Ability system, using weapons or foraging for items improves your skills that lead to improvements when you use that ability

  • Discover hidden secrets of a region with plenty to hide

  • Day/Night cycle with dynamic weather conditions

  • Fully voice acted featuring Australian Streamers Saseffects and ScotchPig.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content not appropriate for all ages. It includes mature content, talk of self-harm and suicide, violence with firearms and horror & scary themes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel Core i5 4690
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X / Intel Core i7-8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 6600 XT / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
